status: Corrected eight analytic-preparation documentation blocks without changing executable syntax, directives or any of12271 compiled methods on either runtime. Current buffer ownership, clipped/contained dispatch and row rewind replace stale construction history. Runtime and original-source qualification remain unchanged.

contracts.storage: Completed edge builders retain their backing buffers under the existing reservation; clipping makes no final edge-array copy. Source contours are borrowed during construction, while walkers own edge, row and event state.
contracts.dispatch: The shared entry point handles clipped and contained construction. Single-contour span helpers are not the complete dispatch contract:directed fills, strokes and flattened payloads retain their distinct gates.
contracts.rows: Every PrepareRow restores edge/curve/link state. Revisiting rows is supported; prior row state ends at the next call. Consumers finish before disposal; each walker remains single-threaded.
contracts.bounds: Source, complete dispatch, construction, row storage and AA paint clips retain separate domains. Fixed state translates after construction in the owning bitmap.
contracts.accounting: The current208-byte edge envelope and all reservations/cancellation checks are unchanged; the historical80-byte note is removed.

sharedModelReview.scope: Existing scene replay, mapped/source polygon preparation, per-bitmap dash filtering and analytic paint traversal. This is a bounded code/contract review, not proof that every historical correctness area is closed.

retained.basis: Readonly scene values and command slices share retained arrays and resource indices; they do not copy scene storage.
Pattern/mask replay borrows the parent-owned sealed scene; it needs no competing replay owner.

Mapped classification coordinates and authored source operands serve distinct rounding/construction stages. Per-bitmap dash filtering changes the emitted outline, so its prepared storage is not an identical copy. No safe removal was established.

The common shader polygon traversal shares coverage setup. Whole-path dispatch, bitmap construction and exclusive painting still require independent bounds; global-stride layer buffers cannot be compacted by changing allocation alone.

sharedModelReview.disposition: No additional redundant owner/tape was established in these seams. Preserve the existing shared implementation and resume witnessed correctness/admission work; do not introduce a general coordinate/replay framework.

validation.roslyn: Every token kind/text and directive is identical; syntax trees are equivalent. Every non-comment source line is also identical.

builds.outputs: Isolated build directories; qualified test/runtime assets were not overwritten.

validation.scope: Documentation-only change. No new tests, native capture, full CI, package or SVGWeb replay is required or claimed for unchanged executable code.

remaining: Named historical source joins and text/shader correctness, original SVGWeb admission semantics and the broader support/units/limits/provenance audit remain open in PLAN.md.
